inspected_model.revision_note: No native model revision identifier was exposed; this verdict applies only to the bound document and inspection snapshot.

checks.expected: One solid, valid body
checks.observed: Native inspection found 1 body; Body.Valid=true and Body.IsSolid=true.

checks.requirement: Native sheet-metal feature health and one bend
checks.expected: Healthy tab, one active 90-degree flange/bend, four cutouts and healthy flat-pattern feature
checks.observed: Feature tree contains one healthy Tab_1, one healthy Flange_1, four healthy cutout features and one healthy Flatten_1; all are active.

checks.expected: Simple L form, equal-width straight-edged arms, four circular holes, no gussets or added features; image supplies no scale
checks.observed: Native inventory shows two perpendicular planar arms joined by one cylindrical bend, four 3.175 mm-radius hole cylinders, and no modeled features beyond tab, flange, four cutouts and flat pattern.
Body document-x extent is 76.2 mm.

checks.requirement: D-02 horizontal outside-apex flange length B-C1
checks.expected: 76.20 mm ±0.762 mm (3.000 in ±0.030 in), measured from virtual outside apex
checks.observed: Outside faces intersect at y=38.6334 mm, while the horizontal free edge is y=-36.6014 mm, giving 75.2348 mm (2.962 in). Error is -0.9652 mm (-0.038 in), exceeding the 0.762 mm tolerance by 0.2032 mm.

checks.requirement: D-03 vertical outside-apex flange length B-C2
checks.expected: 76.20 mm ±0.762 mm (3.000 in ±0.030 in), measured from virtual outside apex
checks.observed: Virtual outside apex is z=2.032 mm and vertical free edge is z=-74.168 mm, giving exactly 76.2 mm.

checks.requirement: D-04 included angle and bend direction
checks.expected: 90.0 degrees ±1.0 degree, one arm formed upward
checks.observed: Primary outside-arm faces have orthogonal normals (0,0,1) and (0,1,approximately 0), with a single quarter-cylinder bend joining horizontal and vertical arms.

checks.expected: 2.032 mm (0.080 in) on both arms
checks.observed: Independent paired-face measurements are 0.002032 m on the horizontal arm and 0.002032 m on the vertical arm; MaterialThickness also reads 2.032 mm.

checks.expected: Inside radius 0.9652 mm (0.038 in), outside radius 2.9972 mm (0.118 in)
checks.observed: Native bend cylinders have radii 0.9652 mm and 2.9972 mm about the same x-axis.
Outside bend cylinder radius and its axis-to-outside-face extents are 2.9972 mm.

checks.expected: Exactly four circular through-holes, diameter 6.35 mm ±0.127 mm
checks.observed: Four non-bend cylindrical faces have radius 3.175 mm and span the full 2.032 mm thickness of their respective arms; topology contains six cylinders total, comprising four holes plus the two bend surfaces.

checks.expected: Centres 19.05 mm and 57.15 mm from the physical left edge, ±0.254 mm, on each arm
checks.observed: Part edges are x=-38.1 and +38.1 mm; all hole axes are at x=-19.05 and +19.05 mm, giving 19.05 and 57.15 mm from the left edge.

checks.requirement: Horizontal-arm hole locations from outside apex Datum B
checks.observed: Horizontal hole axes are y=1.4986 mm and outside apex is y=38.6334 mm, giving 37.1348 mm (1.462 in). Error is -0.9652 mm (-0.038 in), exceeding tolerance.

checks.requirement: Vertical-arm hole locations from outside apex Datum B
checks.observed: Vertical hole axes are z=-36.068 mm and outside apex is z=2.032 mm, giving exactly 38.10 mm.

checks.requirement: Minimum hole, edge and hole-to-hole clearances
checks.expected: Hole diameter at least T; edge ligament and web at least 2T=4.064 mm
checks.observed: Diameter is 6.35 mm >2.032 mm; minimum side ligament is 15.875 mm; free-end ligament is 34.925 mm; hole-to-hole ligament is 31.75 mm. All exceed 4.064 mm.

checks.expected: Hole edges beyond half the 11.9888 mm die width (5.9944 mm) from developed bend centreline
checks.observed: Using the specified R/T/K basis and observed formed locations, both hole rows remain over 32 mm from FBC at their nearest edges, well above 5.9944 mm. Final supplier preview remains a later gate.

checks.requirement: Stock thickness, radius and K-factor rule
checks.expected: T=2.032 mm, R=0.9652 mm, K=0.48 with neutral-factor method
checks.observed: Variables read T=2.032 mm, R=0.9652 mm, NeutralFactor=0.48 and BendCalculationMethod=0 (neutral-factor). Stored generic BA/BD values of 2.09/1.91 mm are nonselected-method values; Design_BendAllowance and Design_BendDeduction record 3.0482245/2.9461755 mm.

checks.expected: Actual native flat length 149.4538245 mm within 0.0254 mm (0.001 in), width 76.2 mm
checks.observed: Flatten_1 is healthy and Design_FlatLength records 149.4538245 mm, but available inspection returned only the formed body's faces/extents; flat-size variables are zero and no native dimension annotations exist. Actual unfolded extents were not measurable with the exposed tools.

checks.requirement: Native CAD material versus supplier stock
checks.expected: Native installed material explicitly naming 5052; supplier requirement remains 5052-H32, 0.080 in
checks.observed: Native readback is 'Aluminum Alloy:3.3523 , AlMg2.5, EN-AW 5052'; catalog search confirms that exact installed entry. It does not identify H32 temper. The design documents 5052-H32 as proposed stock, but supplier confirmation is not native CAD evidence.

checks.expected: Physical A, virtual apex B, free edges C1/C2, FB and FBC are unambiguous
checks.observed: Geometry permits A/B/C measurements, and native reference planes/axes exist, but no dimensions were returned and native datum names do not explicitly identify A, B, C1/C2, FB or FBC.

checks.expected: At least 7.9502 mm (0.313 in)
checks.observed: Both observed formed arms exceed 75 mm.

checks.requirement: Bend-end relief and maximum bending/tool envelope
checks.expected: Applicable supplier relief and forming-envelope requirements resolved
checks.observed: The bend terminates at open exterior edges and no relief feature is modeled. The supplied manufacturing context explicitly leaves supplier-required end relief, maximum bending envelope and tool clearance unresolved pending upload review; native CAD inspection cannot establish supplier acceptance.

checks.expected: Prototype CAD only; no load rating, mating pattern or structural certification claimed
checks.observed: No structural qualification was performed or claimed. The explicit no-load-rating limitation is retained as a scope restriction and does not block prototype CAD review.

corrections: Correct the horizontal arm so its free edge is 76.20 mm from the virtual outside apex; current distance is 75.2348 mm. This requires adding 0.9652 mm to that outside-apex flange dimension while preserving the specified bend rule.

Relocate both horizontal-arm hole centres to 38.10 mm from outside apex Datum B; they are currently 37.1348 mm from B and need to move 0.9652 mm toward the horizontal free end. Preserve their Datum-A coordinates of 19.05 and 57.15 mm.
After correction, obtain authoritative native flat-pattern extents and verify 76.2 x 149.4538245 mm within the stated 0.001 in flat-length tolerance; the design variable alone is insufficient.
Make the A/B/C1/C2/FB/FBC datum mapping explicit in native PMI or other inspectable metadata if these datums are required for downstream inspection.

Retain native 5052 as the catalog-limited assignment but keep supplier stock explicitly 5052-H32, 0.080 in; confirm temper, end-relief handling and bending/tool-envelope acceptance during the later supplier upload gate.
